title: Performance Settings
description: Histogram computation and caching settings, saved to the settings file.

sections.text: Configure performance settings for ndxplorer. These settings control histogram computation, memory usage, and optimization features. Changes take effect after restarting ndxplorer.

sections.label: Use Fast Histogram Optimizations
sections.description: Enables the caching and pre-binning around the fill. The fill itself is always tttrlib and is not affected.

sections.label: Use Parallel Computation
sections.description: Use multiple CPU cores for histogram computation when available.

sections.label: Histogram Threads:
sections.description: -1 uses all available cores, 0/1 disables parallelism.

sections.label: Aggressive Caching
sections.description: Cache more intermediate results for better performance at the cost of higher memory usage.

sections.label: General Cache (MB):
sections.description: Memory limit for general-purpose caching (selections, computations, etc.). Recommended range: 10-500 MB

sections.text: For most users, the default settings provide optimal performance. Advanced users can fine-tune these settings for specific workloads.
Values in settings file override environment variables.

buttons.label: Reset to Defaults
buttons.description: Reset all performance settings to their default values
